FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(SUNGAI BESI-ULU KELANG ELEVATED EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Sungai Besi-Ulu Kelang Elevated Expressway)

(Amendment) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 30 June 2023.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Sungai Besi-Ulu Kelang Elevated Expressway) Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 333/2022],

which is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting

for paragraph 2 the following paragraph:

"Authorization to collect tolls

2. (1) Projek Lintasan Sungai Besi-Ulu Kelang Sdn. Bhd. is authorized—

(a) for the period from 15 October 2022 to 25 December 2069

to demand, collect and retain the appropriate tolls specified

in column (2) of the First Schedule for the use in either

direction, by the classes of vehicles specified in column (1)

of the First Schedule, of any part of the road known

as the Sungai Besi-Ulu Kelang Elevated Expressway

commencing from kilometre 7.128 of Sungai BesiUlu Kelang Elevated Expressway at coordinates

N -66766.516, E 26937.495, Geocentric Datum of Malaysia

(GDM2000) and ending at kilometre 22.984 at coordinates

N -54575.082, E 28287.27, GDM2000 including

the Cheras-Kajang Interchange, Cheras Hartamas

Interchange, Bukit Teratai Toll Plaza, Bukit Teratai

Interchange, Tasik Tambahan Interchange, Permai

Interchange, Kosas Interchange, Ampang Toll Plaza,

Pekan Ampang Interchange, Ampang Point Interchange,

Ulu Kelang Interchange, Hill View Interchange,

Bukit Antarabangsa Interchange and its link roads,

being a distance of 15.856 kilometres; and

(b) for the period from 30 June 2023 to 25 December 2069

to demand, collect and retain the appropriate tolls specified

in column (2) of the First A Schedule for the use in either

direction, by the classes of vehicles specified in column (1)

of the First A Schedule, of any part of the road

known as the Sungai Besi–Ulu Kelang Elevated Expressway

commencing from the main line at kilometre 0.000

at coordinates N -68308.891, E 20957.479, GDM2000

and ending at kilometre 7.128 at coordinates N -66766.516,

E 26937.495, GDM2000 including the Sri Petaling

Interchange, Sungai Besi Interchange, Alam Damai Toll Plaza

and its link roads, being a distance of 7.128 kilometres.

(2) The roads specified—

(a) in subsubparagraph (1)(a) for the use of which

tolls are authorized to be demanded, collected and retained

are shown on the map in the Second Schedule; and

(b) in subsubparagraph (1)(b) for the use of which

tolls are authorized to be demanded, collected and retained

are shown on the map in the Second A Schedule.".

Amendment of First Schedule

3. The First Schedule to the principal Order is amended in the heading

by substituting for the words "subparagraph 2(1)" the words "subsubparagraph 2(1)(a)".

New First A Schedule

4. The principal Order is amended by inserting after the First Schedule

the following schedule:

"FIRST A SCHEDULE

[subsubparagraph 2(1)(b)]

RATES OF TOLLS FOR THE PERIOD FROM 30 JUNE 2023 TO 25 DECEMBER 2069

(1)

Classes of Vehicles

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

Alam Damai Toll Plaza

1. Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxis and buses)

2.30

2. Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels

(excluding buses)

4.60

3. Vehicles having three axles or more (excluding buses) 6.90

4. Taxis 1.20

5. Buses 2.30

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles

and wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Amendment of Second Schedule

5. The Second Schedule to the principal Order is amended in the heading

by substituting for the words "subparagraph 2(2)" the words "subsubparagraph 2(2)(a)".

New Second A Schedule

6. The principal Order is amended by inserting after the Second Schedule

the following schedule:

"SECOND A SCHEDULE

[subsubparagraph 2(2)(b)]

MAP OF SUNGAI BESI-ULU KELANG ELEVATED EXPRESSWAY

".

Made 27 June 2023
